notes: The county reported 164 paid work experiences with 60 employers in 2024. The page also lists an IAmPontiac summer internship; details were not read. Ask about the work permit rule for ages 16 and 17.
name: Oakland NEXT paid internships and career exploration
city: Oakland County, MI (Pontiac and other service centers)
what_you_do: Explore careers, join training, and take part in paid internships with local employers. Each work experience includes learning about career paths and job skills.
who_can_apply: Young adults ages 16 to 24 in Oakland County. Other rules are not listed on the pages read.
pay_detail: Internships are typically paid. Pay rate not stated.
duration: Not stated. Offers summer and year-round internships.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the Oakland NEXT application and staff will contact you.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Oakland NEXT application on the Youth page. Or call 248-858-5520 or email oaklandcountymiworks@oaklandcountymi.gov.
